Changes.note: Bar bars the talebe from one of the medrese's courses, or from all of them, at once; the ban sits at the medrese's kademe and goes to the audit log with its reason. The talebe is told only that their access was removed; a ban placed from this page is notified to no nazım. Lift ban closes the ban with its reason and your name and tells nobody; you cannot lift a ban the köşk's nazım or Medaris administration placed. Bar from the medrese too opens a second ban beside the course ban that closes every course of the medrese. Ask for a permanent ban only records a request: the ban stays as it is, the request cannot be withdrawn, and today it appears on no screen, list or notification of Medaris administration, only in the audit log. Looking a person up by e-mail is written to the audit log too.
